mentions.name: Practical Data
mentions.description: An open-source Chrome extension that highlights and shades numeric data tables on web pages. Because a simple rule like 'big numbers = green' fails for inverted or ambiguous data (e.g., earthquake casualties, batter strikeouts, or a 'cost' column), it uses Jev and other small decision models to determine the cardinality and ordinality of the data before applying shading.
mentions.problem: There is no easy universal rule for shading table data, since many datasets are inverted or ambiguous about whether bigger numbers are better.
